nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV). It's a common respiratory virus that causes symptoms similar to the flu, such as cough, fever, nasal congestion, and brevity of breath. While HMPV is not new and was first discovered in the early 2000s, the recent outbreak has raised global alarm.

nodes.author: RiteshKumarIND
nodes.text: The first case of HMPV has already been reported in Bengaluru, a 8-month-old baby. The Govt is closely monitoring the situation and has increased the number of laboratories testing for HMPV cases. Health authorities are also working with WHO to stay updated on infection trends.
